description: Full-text corpus stage 1: URLs and metadata only, never article text. Per event and outlet: news inside the event window whose title names the event or its outcome, sorted by date and cut to the quota (Tempo 4, Antara 4-8); opinion pieces found the same way are kept but not ingested. found_by is the query that surfaced the article. date_source 'page' is read from the article page; 'id-estimate' is a Tempo date estimated from the article id (Tempo is never fetched by code) and is checked against the page the owner saves.
